mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates labor market slack and weak economic activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 550) and retail sales (RSAFS > 380000) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in stronger economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST > 550 and RSAFS > 380000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signals supply-side weakness and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in reduced corporate output.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses short-term discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to immediate monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate exceeding 13000 (GDPC1 > 13000) indicates robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in sustained corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 13000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading exceeding 220 signals inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST > 550) and GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13000) signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST > 550 and GDPC1 > 13000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
